lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੁਲਿ ਦਿਤੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਪੇਈਐ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabul ditaRee door naa aavai ghar peeeai bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: My father has given me in marriage far away, and I shall not return to my parents' home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹਸੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੀਐ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rahasee vekh hadoor pir raavee ghar soheeai bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: I am delighted to see my Husband Lord near at hand; in His Home, I am so beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਪਿਰ ਲੋੜੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜੋੜੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache pir loRee preetam joRee mat pooree paradhaane ||
lines.translation: My True Beloved Husband Lord desires me; He has joined me to Himself, and made my intellect pure and sublime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲਾ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)jogee melaa thaan suhelaa gunava(n)tee gur giaane ||
lines.translation: By good destiny I met Him, and was given a place of rest; through the Guru's Wisdom, I have become virtuous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh sadaa sach palai sach bolai pir bhaae ||
lines.translation: I gather lasting Truth and contentment in my lap, and my Beloved is pleased with my truthful speech.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vichhuR naa dukh paae guramat a(n)k samaae ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I shall not suffer the pain of separation; through the Guru's Teachings, I merge into the loving embrace of the Lord's Being. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤੁ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 chha(n)t ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Chhant, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham ghar saajan aae ||
lines.translation: My friends have come into my home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachai mel milaae ||
lines.translation: The True Lord has united me with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj milaae har man bhaae pa(n)ch mile sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord automatically united me with them when it pleased Him; uniting with the chosen ones, I have found peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saaee vasat paraapat hoee jis setee man laaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have obtained that thing, which my mind desired.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin mel bhaiaa man maaniaa ghar ma(n)dar sohaae ||
lines.translation: Meeting with them, night and day, my mind is pleased; my home and mansion are beautified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad dhun anahad vaaje ham ghar saajan aae ||1||
lines.translation: The unstruck sound current of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrates and resounds; my friends have come into my home. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu meet piaare ||
lines.translation: So come, my beloved friends,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)gal gaavahu naare ||
lines.translation: And sing the songs of joy, O sisters.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach ma(n)gal gaavahu taa prabh bhaavahu sohilaRaa jug chaare ||
lines.translation: Sing the true songs of joy and God will be pleased. You shall be celebrated throughout the four ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanai ghar aaiaa thaan suhaaiaa kaaraj sabad savaare ||
lines.translation: My Husband Lord has come into my home, and my place is adorned and decorated. Through the Shabad, my affairs have been resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan mahaa ras netree a(n)jan tribhavan roop dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Applying the ointment, the supreme essence, of divine wisdom to my eyes, I see the Lord's form throughout the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee milahu ras ma(n)gal gaavahu ham ghar saajan aaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: So join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of joy and delight; my friends have come into my home. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan a(n)mrit bhi(n)naa ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are drenched with Ambrosial Nectar;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਤੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar prem rata(n)naa ||
lines.translation: deep within the nucleus of my self, is the jewel of the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar ratan padaarath merai param tat veechaaro ||
lines.translation: This invaluable jewel is deep within me; I contemplate the supreme essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖ ਤੂ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)t bhekh too saphalio daataa sir sir devanahaaro ||
lines.translation: Living beings are mere beggars; You are the Giver of rewards; You are the Giver to each and every being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਾਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too jaan giaanee a(n)tarajaamee aape kaaran keenaa ||
lines.translation: You are Wise and All-knowing, the Inner-knower; You Yourself created the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sunahu sakhee man mohan mohiaa tan man a(n)mrit bheenaa ||3||
lines.translation: So listen, O my sisters - the Enticer has enticed my mind. My body and mind are drenched with Nectar. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatam raam sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: O Supreme Soul of the World,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa khel tumhaaraa ||
lines.translation: Your play is true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach khel tumhaaraa agam apaaraa tudh bin kaun bujhaae ||
lines.translation: Your play is true, O Inaccessible and Infinite Lord; without You, who can make me understand?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik siaane kete tujh bin kavan kahaae ||
lines.translation: There are millions of Siddhas and enlightened seekers, but without You, who can call himself one?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਭਏ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal bhae devaane man raakhiaa gur thaae ||
lines.translation: Death and rebirth drive the mind insane; only the Guru can hold it in its place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak avagan sabad jalaae gun sa(n)gam prabh paae ||4||1||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who burns away his demerits and faults with the Shabad, accumulates virtue, and finds God. ||4||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu sajanaa hau dekhaa darasan teraa raam ||
lines.translation: Come, my friend, so that I may behold the blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਪਨੜੈ ਖੜੀ ਤਕਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar aapanaRai khaRee takaa mai man chaau ghaneraa raam ||
lines.translation: I stand in my doorway, watching for You; my mind is filled with such a great yearning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man chaau ghaneraa sun prabh meraa mai teraa bharavaasaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is filled with such a great yearning; hear me, O God - I place my faith in You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan dekh bhaee nihakeval janam maran dukh naasaa ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have become free of desire; the pains of birth and death are taken away.
